sternum_plate_p052.supersedes: R-093 / R-088 full PC sternum plate (0.058 kg)
sternum_plate_p052.design: Chest pad 1 mm CF face is the visible sternum skin at x~+0.147 (37 mm proud). Pad bonded to 7075 land with structural epoxy. 1.5 mm PC bezel ring is secondary hold + cosmetic edge; 4 captive M4s into inserts at (y,z)=(+-0.040, +0.180/+0.260). Flange overlaps face <=4 mm with 1 mm stand-off on compliant gasket (no clamping preload); centre 90x90 free. Edge closed by bezel sidewall + foam seal (seal does not bond to core walls). 0.3-0.5 mm TPU film on face; 15 mm blend to shell.
sternum_plate_p052.service_rule: Visible dent >1 mm deep, or any crush => replace the pad. Crushed face = replace-me indicator.
